newsitem.title: USA: Pennsylvania $72 mln GO refunded bonds AAA - Fitch.
newsitem.headline: Pennsylvania $72 mln GO refunded bonds AAA - Fitch.

text.p: Pennsylvania's $71,725,000 general obligation refunded bonds, 1991 first series A, are rated 'AAA' by Fitch Investors Service.

The 'AAA' rating reflects the fact that the refunded bonds are secured by an irrevocable escrow held in trust by the State Treasurer and composed of direct, non-callable obligations of the U.S. government.
On June 5, 1996, Pennsylvania issued the $213,675,000 refunding series 1996 to advance refund a portion of the state's outstanding general obligation bonds, 1991 first series A, dated Jan. 1, 1991.

The refunded bonds are due to be called on Jan. 1, 2001. Details of the refunded bonds are as follows: $16,225,000 bonds maturing on Jan. 1, 2002 at a redemption price of 101 1/2%, $11,100,000 bonds maturing Jan. 1, 2007 at a redemption price of 101 1/2%, $11,100,000 bonds maturing Jan. 1, 2008 at a redemption price of 101 1/2%, $11,100,000 bonds maturing Jan. 1, 2009 at a redemption price of 101 1/2%, $11,100,000 bonds maturing Jan. 1, 2010 at a redemption price of 101 1/2% and $11,100,000 bonds maturing Jan. 1, 2011 at a redemption price of 101 1/2%.

Drucker and Scaccetti, P.C., has verified the mathematical accuracy of the computations showing the escrowed securities will be sufficient to pay interest, principal and the redemption price of the refunded bonds to the call date without reinvestment.
